claims_and_limits: The real photo pair and synthetic fixture were development fixtures used for threshold selection, not held-out benchmarks.
Synthetic known-transform corner error is independent of fitted inlier error.
Real-photo inlier RMSE is fit to accepted correspondences, not external pose ground truth.
The generated motion is synthetic; no captured live-camera or iPhone/Android result is claimed.
Training uses seeded C library rand and OpenCV RNG; independently trained forests and numeric results may differ by platform.
One unrelated photo plus generated absence frames do not establish a general false-positive rate.
